items.title: In June 2022, Ryker Webb went missing while playing outside his home near Bull Lake, Montana. Search crews spent hours searching through the thick forests as powerful thunderstorms moved across the mountains. Between the freezing temperatures, dangerous animals, and miles of wilderness, it seemed nearly impossible for a child that young to survive on his own. Two days later, Ryker was somehow found alive, hiding inside a lawnmower bag in an isolated shed about two miles from his home. He was freezing, starving, and extremely scared. But how did a 3-year-old manage to survive alone in the wilderness for two days? The mysterious situation quickly led to disturbing theories online, with some people believing something strange could have been hiding in the woods. Others even connected the story to the legend of skinwalkers. Still, nobody but Ryker knows exactly what happened during those 48 hours. #rykerwebb
